# Product brief

This is an existing single-page pricing surface for finance and procurement administrators. Preserve its audience, page boundary, and Contact sales conversion path. Annual pricing is negotiated; no public amount or packaging authority exists in the repository. Visual hierarchy may change, but product commitments may not.
